title: valerianella dentata var. dasycarpa
intro: Valerianella dentata var. dasycarpa, commonly known as Creeping valerian or Corn spurry, is a type of plant that belongs to the valerian family (Valerianaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep. The therapeutic actions of Creeping valerian include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Creeping valerian include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
